_doc: lib/hum-reply-segments.mjs modelPick — which ONE open hum item does each segment of a catch-up reply answer? Questions are built per call (one `choice` per segment over i0..iN + none); this file only carries the site's threshold. There is deliberately NO keyword fallback. Kernel definition; an installation's own data/jev-questions/hum-reply-attribute.json replaces it (lib/jev.mjs jevSiteDef).
